instruction: Lift the foldable laptop's lid gently.

source.instruction: Lift the foldable laptop's lid gently.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the laptop, which was at x = +2 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper inward to x=13, forward to y=-16, and rotate roll -90.8 degrees.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-18, +3, -0) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +19 cm (vertical) from the laptop

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (12, -17, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Orient gripper pitch and yaw to align with lid edge, and descend to z=83.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -11) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the laptop

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (12, -16, 83) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper to (6, -12.5, 79.5) and close gripper to clamp lid edge.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-6, +4, -3) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the laptop; closed the gripper (opening 0.04: holding the laptop)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, -13, 80) opening 0.04; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift slightly by +2.5 cm in z and nudge diagonally (-1, +1, +1) cm to begin opening lid.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +2) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the laptop

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, -13, 82) opening 0.05; table z = 74
frames.plan: Adjust position by (-0.5, +0.5) cm and clamp gripper fully tight.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -0) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +7 cm (vertical) from the laptop

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, -12, 82) opening 0.09; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift right gripper up 3 cm to z=85 to gently open laptop lid.
